sections.name: Hard-truth readiness
questions: Tell us about the most recent piece of feedback that changed your behavior.
What belief about your business might currently be wrong?
What would your team say you avoid confronting?
When results miss the target, what do you examine first in your own leadership?

sections.name: Execution evidence
questions: What meaningful change did you implement in the last 30 days?
How quickly do you normally implement agreed actions?
Provide one example where you kept executing after motivation faded.
Which three KPIs do you review every week?

callTests: Challenge one assumption respectfully and observe whether the founder becomes curious or defensive.
Ask the founder to identify their own contribution to the current constraint.
Assign one small pre-call action and record speed and quality of completion.
Ask for exact numbers rather than confidence-based descriptions.
decisionPolicy: Never infer personality from protected traits, wealth, confidence, accent, education, or charisma. Score only documented behavior, business evidence, implementation history, financial fit, and responses to direct but respectful feedback.
